headline: How AI Data Centers Get Financed: Joint Ventures, Leases, and What Communities Should Watch
summary: Read AI campus headlines as financing documents: ownership, offtake, debt, contracted revenue, and reservation rights are different claims.
body:
Gigawatt AI campuses are financing stories as much as technology stories.

In our latest guide, we separate joint ventures, long-term leases, residual-value guarantees, and reservation rights—and explain what communities should ask before a press-release number becomes a local obligation.

Practical takeaway: ownership ≠ offtake ≠ contracted revenue.
